items.caption: FrontEnd Dev.
items.txt:
For over three years, I have worked as a FrontEnd Developer, focusing on code quality, system architecture, and technical decision-making. I participated in key projects such as the development of the company's commercial website using Next.js and AEM, the modernization of a B2B2C system using microfrontends with React in TypeScript, and the implementation of a B2B AMB for corporate balance management using Next.js, React, Chakra UI, TS, Jest, and Storybook.
Beyond development, I played an active role in mentoring teammates, optimizing processes, and enhancing the DX through automation, testing, CI/CD, migrations, and rendering optimization. My approach combines a high technical level with a strategic vision for system scalability and maintainability.
